watch.summary: A streamer realizes he is cursing a esports player every time he speaks, so he commits to total silence until the team wins the round.

beats.what: Streamer hypes up the player on screen.
The player dies instantly and streamer goes quiet.
Streamer tries hyping the player again to clutch the round.
Player is headshot and eliminated mid-sentence.
Streamer realizes his speech is a jinx and vows to stay quiet.
Streamer maintains dramatic silence while watching the match.
100 Thieves wins the round while he remains silent.
Streamer breaks silence to celebrate the victory.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Let's see you clutch up this one.
watch.why: The instant headshot perfectly timed with the streamer's optimistic commentary creates a classic caster-curse moment. His commitment to sitting in complete silence to successfully secure the round win gives the joke a great resolution.
